pages.text: Lately you've noticed more types of zombies, and some of these unique variants have piqued your curiosity.

These zombies that crawl out of swamps are covered in thick mud, which provides them with extra armor and a small amount of magic protection, but also makes them slower. Their attacks slow their victims and inflict them with potent poison.

Summoning Zombies in a swamp biome will summon Mired Servants, or you can summon them using a witch's wand. Wearing a crone's uniform makes your Mired Servants' attacks inflict Acid Venom instead of Poison on their targets.

pages.text: Requirements: $(li)Gravestone is located in a Swamp biome $(br)$(l)OR$()$() $(li)15 Mud Blocks $(li)1 Cauldron
